ActorTalk: Placing a "campfire" at the center—Babylonia and the Forest Guard share that habit.
And those drifting ribbons of light... they remind me of the aurora.
Maybe we're not as different as we believed.
Someday, the children on the ground will see the sky's projections, and the children above will see the auroras below—our worlds becoming one.
They're both sources of light, when you think about it.
